remarks:
Located on a residential block near Adams Street, 52 Peckham Street offers an affordable entry point for land ownership or small-scale development. The parcel measures approximately 28 x 128 feet (.0771 acres) and provides ample depth for a new home, garden, or investment hold.

The lot sits within an area experiencing steady reinvestment and could complement nearby redevelopment opportunities. Whether used for future building plans or as part of a broader assemblage strategy, this property represents a practical and accessible opportunity in Buffalo’s East Side market.

Additional Opportunity:
This property can also be purchased as part of a larger assemblage including nine lots on Peckham Street totaling approximately 0.91 acres (MLS #B1665930), a 27,806 sq feet church with school on .52 acres(MLS #B1665688), and the parsonage duplex at 308 Adams Street (MLS #B1665682) The combined properties offer expanded development potential and flexibility for a larger project footprint.  Equal Housing Opportunity!
